instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/assembled.brd` is the assembled board. Run EAGLE's bundled `mountsmd.ulp` to obtain the component placements, then normalize its native output into two CSV files named `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_top.csv` and `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_bottom.csv`. Each file must have the header `Name,Value,Package,X,Y,Rotation,Side`; the top file must contain the top-side components with `Side` set to `top`, and the bottom file must contain the bottom-side components with `Side` set to `bottom`. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
